description: This bar chart illustrates Token Ratio (TR) performance for three models—RedWhale (our), EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base)—across six categories: PT-EVAL, KoBEST-BQ, KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-HS, KoBEST-SN, and AVG. The horizontal axis displays the categories, listed in the order PT-EVAL through AVG, while the vertical axis represents the TR value, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0 with tick intervals of 0.1. Within each category, three bars are grouped together, with RedWhale represented in dark blue, EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 in light blue, and SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 in gray. The SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 bars are consistently the tallest, each reaching a value of 1.00. RedWhale bars range in height from approximately 0.42 in PT-EVAL to 0.73 in KoBEST-SN, while EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 bars range from approximately 0.52 in KoBEST-BQ to 0.50 in KoBEST-HS. The bars are not sorted, and no bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
caption_used: The bar chart illustrates the Token Ratio (TR) performance of three models across six categories: PT-EVAL, KoBEST-BQ, KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-HS, KoBEST-SN, and AVG. The vertical axis ranges from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick intervals of 0.1. Each category contains three bars representing RedWhale (our), EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base), respectively. Notably, SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 consistently outperforms the other models across all categories, achieving a perfect score of 1.00 in each case. RedWhale demonstrates a steady improvement across the datasets, with its highest performance observed in KoBEST-SN (approximately 0.73). In contrast, EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 shows a decline in performance from KoBEST-BQ to KoBEST-HS, where it achieves its lowest score of 0.50. On average, RedWhale slightly surpasses EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, with a mean score of 0.61 compared to 0.57.
